citations.title: Travel policy, section 2.4: Hotels
citations.cited_text: Hotel stays are reimbursed up to the nightly cap for the destination city listed in the rate table. Room upgrades are not reimbursable unless the standard room is unavailable and you note this on the expense report. Loyalty points earned on business stays belong to the employee.
